recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: phantom citations multiplying in AI-assisted research papers
tinkerers slipping through forgotten ports in old TV firmware
satellite links steadying after bandwidth throttling
clear autumn night over San Francisco, eleven degrees and still
parallel agents sketching different futures in the same chat

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Stamp out ghost footnotes in a research draft before each phantom cite splits into two — miss one and the bibliography blooms with fiction.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: tap to eliminate fake citations before they branch
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: chain reactions when you intercept a cite just before it forks
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: citations spawn faster and hide behind legitimate references
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: chalkboard manuscript with glowing red phantom ink

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Shield a single match flame as Karl the fog rolls through San Francisco — hold warmth through gusts that snuff pockets of light.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: hold/release to protect flame from wind and fog
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: narrow escapes when fog almost douses the flame at the last second
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: fog thickens, wind shifts direction, flame shrinks between waves
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor night skyline with amber flame glow

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Swipe between three agent lanes each proposing a different patch — merge the right diff before the codebase drifts off vision.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: lane switch and sort overlapping proposals
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: snap moment when three partial solutions collapse into one clean diff
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more agents join, proposals overlap, decision window shrinks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon terminal split-screen with soft bloom

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick Tcl tokens through a lattice of hidden TV menu ports — each successful ricochet unlocks a deeper layer of the firmware tree.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: physics flick through rotating port lattice
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: discovering a secret menu depth feels like buried treasure
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: ports rotate, gravity shifts, wrong bounces cost a layer
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: retro CRT scanlines with amber phosphor text
